purpose: Account of temporary AWS access for workshops and agents

required_facts.fact: The workshop needed AWS for 50–60 participants.
The author avoided sharing long-lived keys and main-account access.
A Lambda returned temporary role credentials.
A sandbox account and Codespaces template were used.
A secret check protected the public endpoint.
aws-sandbox-cli gives agents about an hour of access.
The production database incident motivated isolation.

author_attribution: Attribute the workshop and tooling to Alexey, retaining the security qualifications and limits.
